**U.S. Senate convenes on 34th day of shutdown with no vote taken**
The U.S. Senate reconvened on November 3, 2025, for the 34th day of a federal government shutdown, with no vote taken on a funding bill despite 13 failed procedural votes on a House-passed continuing resolution (CR) that would fund the government through November 21.
